user.title: Bosch EasyAir
user.description: Choose a setup method. Browser login is recommended; manual setup is only for tokens captured from an EasyAir session.

browser_login.title: Sign in with Bosch/SingleKey
browser_login.description: Copy the Bosch/SingleKey login URL, open it in your browser, sign in, and paste the final `idsmobileapp://?...` redirect URL or its `code` value below.

manual.title: Manual config with tokens
manual.description: Use this only if you already captured tokens from a valid EasyAir session.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Bosch EasyAir
reauth_confirm.description: The stored EasyAir token is no longer valid. Choose how to re-authenticate.

error.missing_authorization_response: Enter the authorization redirect URL or code

abort.already_configured: This EasyAir account is already configured
abort.reauth_entry_missing: The EasyAir configuration entry being re-authenticated no longer exists
abort.wrong_account: The re-authenticated account does not match the configured EasyAir account
